articles.title: Plus un matériau est petit, plus il est résistant : pourquoi les nanoparticules sont mille fois plus résistantes que le même métal à notre échelle
articles.summary:
Comme le dit le dicton, « tout ce qui est petit est mignon ». Mais il est plus rare d’entendre dire que ce qui est plus petit est plus costaud. Et pourtant c’est ce qu’il semble se passer pour de nombreux matériaux si on diminue leurs dimensions jusqu’à quelques dizaines de nanomètres (un milliardième de mètre). Des expériences et des simulations numériques montrent en effet que la résistance mécanique peut augmenter d’un facteur mille à ces échelles. Comment cela est-il possible ?
Revenons tout d’abord aux bases. Si on compresse un matériau, il se déforme généralement avec une amplitude faible et de manière élastique, c’est-à-dire réversible. Toutefois, au-delà d’un certain niveau de contrainte mécanique exercée, la déformation devient plastique donc irréversible. Ce seuil de résistance mécanique maximal dépend bien évidemment du type de matériau. L’acier est ainsi notoirement plus résistant que du plomb, et une pierre que du polystyrène. Physiquement, cette résistance est équivalente à une pression, laquelle s’exprime en pascal (Pa) dans le système d’unités international. Par exemple, la pression maximale que peut supporter un métal comme l’aluminium est une vingtaine de mégapascals, soit 2×107 Pa.

articles.title: Hay una paradójica razón por la que millones de discos duros perfectamente funcionales se desechan cada año
articles.summary:
La idea de “tirar a la basura” componentes informáticos totalmente operativos y con alrededor de media década de antigüedad puede tener muy poco sentido si pensamos en los mercados de segunda mano e incluso en reducir los desechos electrónicos. Para muchas compañías, sin embargo, tiene sentido, al menos cuando de discos duros se trata.
Cada año, millones de dispositivos de almacenamiento se dirigen obligadamente hacia un único destino: la destrucción. Y no importa que todavía funcionen e incluso que, en caso de ser vendidos, puedan retribuirles una importante cantidad de dinero a sus antiguos propietarios. Se trata de una práctica que en estos tiempos no deja de sorprender.
Stellar Info, basándose en datos del Laboratorio Nacional de Energía Renovable de Estados Unidos (hoy rebautizado como Laboratorio Nacional de las Montañas Rocosas), señala que al menos unos 20 millones de discos son destruidos anualmente en ese país. Este escenario se repite una y otra vez en diferentes partes del mundo y, por lo general, tiene un punto en común: que es impulsado por empresas y gobiernos.
Nombres como Amazon, Microsoft y Google, en el universo tecnológico, así como departamentos u oficinas gubernamentales de todo tipo, bancos y agencias de seguridad suelen confiar en la destrucción de los dispositivos de almacenamiento como una solución efectiva y sin vueltas para evitar que datos confidenciales acaben en manos indebidas.

articles.title: 5 Lessons to learn from Nexus by Yuval Noah Harari
articles.summary:
5 Lessons to learn from Nexus by Yuval Noah Harari
Discover five key lessons from Yuval Noah Harari’s Nexus on information, power, artificial intelligence and how networks shape society.
Information has always shaped human civilisation. From ancient stories and religious texts to newspapers, television and social media, the way people share information influences what they believe, how they make decisions and whom they trust.
In Nexus, historian and author Yuval Noah Harari examines how information networks have shaped human history and how they may influence our future. Published in 2024, the book explores the relationship between information, power, truth and the development of artificial intelligence.
Harari challenges the assumption that having more information automatically makes societies wiser or better informed.
What matters is how information is organised, who controls it and whether the systems that distribute it help people correct their mistakes. Here are five important lessons to learn from Nexus and how they apply to the world we live in today.
5 Lessons to learn from Nexus by Yuval Noah Harari
1. More information does not always mean more truth
One of the most important lessons from Nexus is that the availability of information does not automatically make people better informed.

Le groupe bancaire britannique Barclays a annoncé, jeudi 22 octobre, la suppression d'environ 5 000 postes en 2026, dans le cadre d'un programme destiné à réduire durablement ses coûts de fonctionnement. Une restructuration que la banque associe notamment à ses investissements technologiques et aux gains de productivité permis par l'intelligence artificielle.
Sur les 5 000 postes concernés, environ 1 000 ont déjà disparu. Les 4 000 autres suppressions sont prévues d'ici la fin de l'année, a précisé la directrice financière Anna Cross, citée par Reuters.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a memo warning military personnel against using nonpublic information to make bets on prediction markets, saying the wagers could give important clues to enemy countries.
“Do Not Compromise Military Operations for Personal Financial Gain,” said the subject line of an October 20 memo published yesterday by CBS News. Hegseth’s memo was sent to senior Pentagon leadership, Combatant Command leaders, and Defense Department field activity directors.
Hegseth wrote:
Our enemies watch movements in these markets. When an American Service member, intelligence professional, or other Department civilian engages in a financial transaction on a military outcome, they create a signal. That signal can be aggregated, correlated, and exploited by hostile foreign intelligence services to anticipate our movements, targets, and timing. The lives of our Service members often depend on the enemy not knowing what is coming. The men and women who carry our flag into harm’s way deserve a Force that protects them—not one that exposes them to the enemy for personal gain.
In April, a US Army soldier was arrested and charged with using confidential information to make $410,000 in Polymarket bets on the timing of the military’s capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro. Bengaluru-based Ultraviolette—which produces high-performance electric motorcycles—says it will not pass on the high input costs to customers and is exploring other ways to tide over the situation.
Memory chips are a critical component of an electric vehicle, used to store data, run control software, and manage real-time operations across critical systems.

AI data centres are projected to consume 70% of global memory chip production in 2026. The data centre boom has led to a supply crunch, subsequently shoring up costs of chips.

articles.title: China can make advanced chips without EUV, but the bill keeps growing

China can make advanced chips without EUV, but the bill keeps growing — DUV multiple patterning means bigger dies, lower yields, and longer manufacturing times
China has shown that older DUV lithography can be stretched much further than many expected – but can it fully catch up?
Export controls have kept ASML's most advanced EUV lithography machines out of China. Instead, the country's chipmaking industry has relied on less-capable deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines. By using multiple exposures on critical chip layers, these older machines are still capable of producing performant silicon. However, as multiple patterns are applied there are more chances for defects, longer manufacturing times, and higher bills. We spoke to experts like Chris Mack, co-founder and CTO of semiconductor firm Fractilia, to find out how much further DUV can go.
For years, extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography has been seen as China’s biggest choke point in the country’s attempts to build cutting-edge chips. The machines, made exclusively by Dutch manufacturer ASML, use 13.5nm-wavelength light to print some of the most intricate features found on modern processors. Sales of ASML’s EUV systems are subject to export restrictions, forcing Chinese manufacturers to squeeze ever more out of older deep ultraviolet, or DUV, lithography instead. The EUV gap alone between China and the West is at least half a decade, according to some analysts.

Additionally, the Blue Origin plans allows for the possibility of its Blue Moon lander rendezvousing with Orion in low-Lunar orbit.

articles.title: How to avoid AI's 'valley of despair' - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
How to avoid AI’s ‘valley of despair’
Amdahl’s Law states that improving a single part of a system can only speed up the whole system so much. Even if one step of a process becomes exponentially faster, the other steps impose a ceiling unless they, too, are accelerated.
This concept may explain some of the disappointment companies are experiencing with artificial intelligence. An AI assistant can draft a proposal in seconds, but it then sits for days waiting on reviews, pricing and approval. Similarly, a coding tool can produce software in minutes, but testing, security and deployment still take days or weeks.
Companies have accelerated specific tasks without reengineering the systems that surround them. This gap between inflated expectations and modest returns is what some are calling AI’s “valley of despair.”
After a period of vigorous adoption and experimentation, executives are now being confronted with ever-growing costs and limited proof of bottom-line impact. Analyst firm Forrester Research Inc. recently found that only 15% of AI decision-makers reported an increase in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization over the past 12 months. Fewer than one-third could clearly map the value of AI back to bottom-line changes.
This skepticism is healthy; AI investments should face the same scrutiny as any other capital expense. Leaders need to be clear on expected returns, timelines and milestones that show whether their investment delivers measurable busine…

articles.title: Qué es y cómo funciona la tecnología de ultracongelación por aire forzado para carnes y vegetales
articles.summary:
Los congeladores modernos incorporaron manipulación térmica activa para controlar la temperatura y la velocidad de enfriamiento, argumentando los fabricantes que es para preservar la textura, el sabor y el valor nutricional de los alimentos.
La congelación tradicional a -18 °C enfrentó un límite estructural: el enfriamiento lento formó macrocristales de hielo dentro de carnes y vegetales. Esas estructuras rompieron las paredes celulares y, durante la descongelación, favorecieron la pérdida de jugos, nutrientes solubles y firmeza.
La ultracongelación por flujo de aire forzado aceleró el proceso hasta cinco veces frente a un congelador estándar. La mayor velocidad solidificó el agua en microcristales que no alteraron la membrana celular, por lo que los alimentos retuvieron mejor su estado tras descongelarse.
Microcristales y conservación sin daño celular de los alimentos
La subcongelación suave a -3 °C se ubicó entre la refrigeración convencional, de 4 °C, y el congelamiento profundo. En carnes y pescados, esa temperatura cristalizó solo la capa externa de las proteínas.
Según Panasonic, el método que implementaron permitió conservar ingredientes durante hasta siete días sin petrificarlos. Los alimentos quedaron listos para cortar y cocinar, sin los tiempos de espera propios de la descongelación ni los cambios bruscos de ambiente asociados a la proliferación bacteriana.

Depending on where you sit as an investor, artificial intelligence still looks like a massive opportunity, or it’s now looking way too risky given growing infrastructure investments and the public’s souring on AI and all the data centers needed to power it.

But on Thursday, continued worry about potentially excessive data center spending — such as at Meta, which plans to issue new shares to pay for even more expansion — knocked AI stocks such as SpaceX and CoreWeave way down Thursday.
That volatility isn’t likely to change anytime soon, as more big earnings reports are coming next week, including the major cloud and AI providers Amazon, Alphabet and Microsoft as well as Intel. Elle propose même de générer des romans à votre place : 260 $ pour un livre unique et 705 $ pour une trilogie.
Près de 400 romans écrits à l’aide de l’IA en moins de 2 ans
En l’espace de 20 mois, Coral Hart a écrit, ou plutôt généré, 371 romans à l’aide de l’intelligence artificielle. Un chiffre qui donnerait certainement le tournis à George R. R. Martin, l’auteur de Game of Thrones. Le processus de travail de Coral Hart est relativement simple. Tout d’abord, elle établit les grandes lignes de l’histoire, les personnages ou encore la structure globale du livre. Ensuite, elle fournit ces indications à une IA qui délivre un texte. Cependant, Coral Hart explique que la première version est systématiquement « mauvaise ». C’est pourquoi elle demande à une autre IA d’harmoniser l’ensemble notamment la continuité du récit et la cohérence globale. Enfin, un relecteur humain s’assure que l’IA n’a pas laissé d’erreur ou d’incohérence. Il peut même réécrire certains passages s’il le faut.

articles.summary:
Ce mardi 20 octobre 2026, deux failles critiques ont été découvertes dans le langage informatique PHP qui est utilisé par environ 70 % des sites à travers le monde. La situation s’est révélée être un véritable casse-tête pour l’Internet mondial, tant le langage PHP est omniprésent, mais aussi souvent invisible. Certains sites ont d’ailleurs pris la décision de se mettre tout simplement hors ligne, à l’image d’Orange, qui a suspendu temporairement l’accès à certains de ses sites et applications par mesure de précaution. L’Internet mondial a donc connu une période de crise, et cela ne devrait pas s’arranger si l’on en croit les propos de Jason Clinton, responsable adjoint de la sécurité des systèmes d’information chez Anthropic.

Venture capital funding in the third week of October recorded a sharp fall due to lower number of deals and absence of large value transactions.
Venture capital funding for Indian startups saw a steep decline in the third week of October, primarily due to a lower number of deals and the absence of any large-value transactions.
Venture capital funding during the week stood at just $96 million across 15 deals. In contrast, startups raised a total of $180 million in the previous week.
This sharp drop in venture capital funding highlights the challenges the Indian startup ecosystem continues to face in raising a steady flow of capital. This is also the eighth time so far this year that weekly venture capital funding has fallen below the $100 million mark.
The only large deal during the week was Even Healthcare’s $50 million raise. The other deals were worth $11 million or less. While transactions during the week saw investors place their bets across segments such as healthcare, consumer and AI, there were no other significant deals.
The biggest challenge for the Indian startup ecosystem so far this year has been the low number of large-value deals. In fact, there have been just 16 deals worth $100 million or more. This does not bode well for the ecosystem as 2026 draws to a close.
However, there is hope for a revival in 2027.

Uno de los resultados mostró a la candidata republicana al Senado por Iowa Ashley Hinson en una fiesta junto al delincuente sexual condenado Jeffrey Epstein. No existe ninguna prueba de que ambos se hayan conocido o hayan sido fotografiados juntos.
Hinson había sido criticada por legisladores demócratas por oponerse a una moción para forzar la publicación completa de los archivos del caso Epstein, lo que explica por qué la imagen falsa buscó vincularla con ese escándalo.
Consultado por NewsGuard, un portavoz de OpenAI dijo: “Prohibimos el uso de nuestras herramientas para interferir en elecciones o desalentar el voto, y monitoreamos y tomamos medidas de manera activa contra los usuarios que lo intentan”.

Lamm disse ao TechCrunch que a primeira leva entrará em breve no processo de clonagem e incubação, e os primeiros filhotes são esperados para o início de 2027. articles.title: NATO jammers will block out GPS for miles around — and they could be the secret weapon in the next big conflict
articles.summary:
NATO jammers will block out GPS for miles around — and they could be the secret weapon in the next big conflict
After three years of Russian GPS jamming over Europe's eastern flank, NATO has decided its crews need to train against the real thing
- NATO's modernization command plans to buy six portable kits that can jam GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou, plus drone control and video links
- The blackout radius is adjustable from 500 m to 11 km, and each kit must deploy in 30 minutes, run for four hours on battery, and be controllable remotely over encrypted satellite links
- The purchase is a direct response to years of Russian-blamed GPS interference over the Baltic, including the 2025 jamming of the President of the European Commission's aircraft over Bulgaria
NATO is shopping for the ability to make satellite navigation disappear, on command, over an area the size of a small city.
The alliance's modernization command has signaled plans to buy six portable kits that can jam satellite navigation signals and the radio links drones use for control and video, so trainers can expose ships, aircrews, and drone operators to realistic interference during exercises.

Capcom has confirmed that an unauthorized third party accessed customer data tied to CAPCOM ID, the shared account used for the company's web services and for online play in some of its games. According to Capcom's official notice, a massive 11,774,247 records were affected worldwide, each containing an email address along with the account creation date, last login time, login count, and the IP address from the most recent sign-in. Capcom spotted the suspicious activity on October 19, started blocking it the same day, and reported the incident to the Osaka Prefectural Police and Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission on October 21. A much smaller group of 43 records also exposed dates of birth, gender, country or region, and nicknames. 
The attackers changed the login passwords on 196 accounts too, and Capcom has since reset them. A follow-up notice on October 23 adds that the intruder opened the e-Capcom store pages of 19 of those accounts, exposing names, phone numbers, addresses, and purchase history for those customers in Japan. Capcom says it found no sign that customer-set passwords were compromised, and credit card information was not affected. Capcom hasn't said how the attackers got in, only that the method has been identified and dealt with. CAPCOM ID and Capcom's games remain available. Point Vision vient d’envoyer un e-mail à ses patients pour les informer d’une cyberattaque. Elle a touché le prestataire chargé d’organiser ses rendez-vous.

articles.title: "No hay esperanza para los glaciares del Pirineo". Las fotos del Aneto tras el verano sugieren un colapso climático extremo

El cambio climático está agravando la desertificación de España y, en el proceso, desestabilizando brutalmente el caudal de los ríos y haciendo que los Pirineos sean más mediterráneos que nunca. Y eso implica también decir adiós a uno de los pocos glaciares que hay en la península Ibérica: el del Aneto. Como una imagen vale más que mil palabras, bajo estas líneas verás dos fotografías del Aneto, de 2015 y 2026. El cambio es evidente: donde antes había un cuerpo blanco de nieve y hielo, ahora domina la roca desnuda y el hielo sucio.
La agonía del Aneto. La descorazonadora imagen que muestran las dos fotografías no debería pillarnos por sorpresa. El resultado son tres masas de hielo desconectadas, un estado muy distinto al de 2015.
Los resultados preliminares de la campaña de final de este verano apuntan a una pérdida de más de dos metros de espesor medio, que deja el grosor medio del glaciar en torno a los 12 metros. The UBP-X700/K only launched on May 17, 2025, as a cut-down version of the 2018 UBP-X700 without streaming apps, and it was last listed at ¥58,300. Sony will keep selling the BDP-S1700/K, though that one only handles regular Blu-ray discs.
The PS5 is not a perfect stand-in for home theater enthusiasts either. It handles 4K Blu-ray with HDR10, but it lacks Dolby Vision support, which the UBP-X700/K offered. Sony has also announced that new PlayStation games will stop shipping on disc from January 2028, and it hasn't confirmed whether the PS6 will even have a disc drive, despite an earlier report of a detachable one. If it doesn't, the PS5 becomes Sony's last disc player, and with a successor on the way, its days are numbered too. articles.summary:
Attackers are exploiting a zero-day SQL injection flaw in Arista's VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO), the central management system for VeloCloud SD-WAN networks, the company said in an advisory on October 22.
The flaw lets anyone who can log in to the orchestrator, even with a read-only customer account, gain operator privileges, the top level of control over it.
For on-premises orchestrators, the fix is in VCO 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10, and 6.4.2.12, while Hosted and Dedicated orchestrators have already been patched.
The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-114625 and rated 9.9 on the CVSS scale. Orchestrators running the releases that fixed the VCO flaws exploited in July and September are still affected, because those releases are older than the new fixes.
Arista bought the VeloCloud SD-WAN product line from Broadcom, announcing the deal in July 2025. The products were earlier known as VMware SD-WAN by VeloCloud.
To exploit the flaw, an attacker needs network access to the orchestrator's web interface and a valid login. The minimum role is Enterprise Read Only, the lowest built-in role for customer users. VCO is exposed by default, and no VCO setting prevents the exposure.
In VCO, operators create the customer and partner accounts, and each partner can manage a group of customers. The flaw allows an attacker to act as a local superuser, a role with full access. It may also allow an attacker to affect the VCO host itself and expose, modify, or disrupt the orchestrator and the data it manages.

AMD has published HIPRT 3.2, the latest version of its ray tracing library for HIP, and the release notes name the integrated graphics of its upcoming Zen 6 "Medusa" processors outright. Under new features, AMD lists Medusa support for three GPU architecture IDs: gfx1170, gfx1171, and gfx115E. HIPRT is mostly used by rendering apps like Blender, so this says nothing about gaming performance. Still, the link between these IDs and Medusa has so far rested on compiler patches and leaks, and now the Medusa name sits right in AMD's own changelog.
The gfx117x IDs belong to RDNA 4m, which first showed up in LLVM back in February. AMD added GFX1171 and GFX1172 targets in March, merged GFX1171 into Mesa 26.3 in August, and pushed RDNA 4m firmware later that month. Despite the name, RDNA 4m sits in the GFX11 family with RDNA 3 and 3.5, plus a few RDNA 4 style additions like FP8/BF8 conversion and new matrix instructions. The gfx115E entry is the more curious one. GFX115x covers the RDNA 3.5 graphics in Strix Point and Strix Halo, so it looks like at least one Medusa chip could stick with RDNA 3.5. The same release fixes a bug that truncated architecture numbers containing a letter, gfx115E included.AMD hasn't said which Medusa parts get which GPU, and the notes don't separate Medusa Point from Halo. articles.title: Critical x402 SDK Flaw Could Let Malicious APIs Drain AI Agents’ Token Balances
articles.summary:
AI agents paying for API calls with the x402 SDKs could sign a payment for their full balance of a supported token if a malicious API asked for it, security firm V12 said on October 22.
The cause was the SDKs' default client, which set no spending limit until releases on August 18 added one. The risk was limited to agents who automatically signed payments and whose apps set no limits.
The missing limit is one of 25 flaws V12 found in the x402 code, and one of three it rated critical and described in detail. The x402 Foundation, which maintains the SDKs, had already fixed all three critical flaws in the August 18 releases.
One of the other two let a facilitator, the service that checks x402 payments, accept a Solana transaction that moved no tokens as a valid payment. Among the x402 SDKs, only the TypeScript one had this flaw. The other let a malicious server get an agent to sign a login message for a different website.
V12 found the flaws by reviewing the code and running local tests. Neither V12 nor the x402 Foundation has publicly reported any attacks using them.
The foundation has published no security advisory for the three flaws, and its changelogs list the fixes without calling them security fixes. As of October 23, npm audit returned no advisories for the last TypeScript releases before the fixes, and PyPI listed no vulnerabilities for the last Python release before them, The Hacker News found. A developer who relies on those checks gets no warning to upgrade.

articles.title: Researchers Demonstrate Node2Shell RCE Exploit on Node.js Build Using Crafted Brotli Data
articles.summary:
Malicious Brotli data can make an application on an official build of Node.js run attacker-supplied code, security researchers at Imperva have demonstrated.
Their "Node2Shell" proof of concept ran code on the official Node.js 24.22.0 image for Linux arm64, with no debugger or custom build, by feeding crafted data to the bundled Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497). Node.js disclosed the flaw and released fixes on October 21, and applications that decode untrusted Brotli data should update.
Imperva's test did not succeed on every attempt, and code execution took several tries in its Linux arm64 setup. The result covers that one build and application setup, with other architectures and the 22.x and 26.x lines not tested. On the fixed release, 24.22.1, the same data was rejected, and no code ran.
The demonstration goes beyond the first public proof of concept, which achieved code execution only on a deliberately weakened test build. On a standard build, that proof of concept's author reported a crash and a limited read of process memory, not code execution, and said a working attack on a normal build was not achieved.
No exploitation of the flaw in the wild has been reported as of October 22.

articles.title: Cómo limpiar la licuadora y quitarle el mal olor: desde el motor hasta el vaso, según fabricantes
articles.summary:
Mantener limpia la licuadora puede ser útil para evitar residuos, derrames y malos olores, pero la tarea puede resultar compleja por la presencia de cuchillas, anillos selladores, juntas y una base con componentes eléctricos. La limpieza debe hacerse después de cada uso y con el aparato desconectado.
Para quitar el mal olor, es necesario retirar los restos de alimentos del vaso, las cuchillas y las juntas, lavarlos con agua tibia y detergente y dejar que se sequen por completo.
La humedad y los residuos acumulados pueden afectar el sabor de las preparaciones y generar olores desagradables.
Según las recomendaciones de Oster, conviene revisar el anillo sellador y el sistema de cuchillas antes de usar el equipo. Si las piezas están mal ubicadas, dañadas o flojas, pueden producir fugas, dificultar la limpieza y afectar el funcionamiento de la licuadora.
Cómo limpiar el vaso de una licuadora
Antes de comenzar, desenchufa la licuadora y retira el vaso de la base del motor. Si el modelo lo permite, desenrosca el sistema de cuchillas de la parte inferior y separa las juntas de goma para lavarlas por separado.
Este paso facilita la eliminación de restos que pueden quedar atrapados en las uniones.
Lava el vaso con agua tibia y unas gotas de detergente. Usa una esponja suave para limpiar el interior y evita los materiales abrasivos, que pueden rayar el plástico o el vidrio.

Aux heures creuses, quand les bus passent rarement, des habitants du nord-ouest du Grand Paris pourraient appeler un véhicule sans conducteur sur l’application Bolt à partir de 2028. Bolt, Stellantis et la Métropole du Grand Paris préparent cette expérimentation dans cinq communes au maximum, et espèrent ouvrir un service commercial dans une trentaine de villes en 2030.
Avec ses 7,2 millions d’habitants, la Métropole du Grand Paris compte sur le Grand Paris Express pour mieux relier ses communes, mais certains trajets sont mal desservis, entre la gare et le domicile ou vers des pôles d’emploi. Stellantis fournira pour ce projet des véhicules capables de rouler sans conducteur dans une zone délimitée, et Bolt fera fonctionner le service avec sa filiale Bolt Autonomous Driving Solutions, sous la coordination de la Métropole. En France, aucun service commercial de robotaxi à la demande n’est autorisé à ce jour. articles.title: Critical Flaw in Python’s Popular Pillow Image Library Allows Code Execution via a Crafted Image
articles.summary:
Pillow, the most widely used image library for Python, can be made to run operating system commands on a server by specifying the name of a file it is told to open.
The flaw, CVE-2026-112900, is in the way Pillow handles EPS images, which it opens by passing the file's name to Ghostscript, a separate program it runs to turn the image into pixels, without checking the name first.
Ghostscript can read a name chosen by an attacker as instructions rather than as a file, and point it to a second file that carries commands to run. Pillow's maintainers fixed it in version 13.0.0, released on October 16.
Pillow turns up almost everywhere Python handles images: web upload forms, avatar and thumbnail tools, document and PDF pipelines, and most machine-learning projects pull it in. OX Security, the firm whose report drew attention to the flaws, estimates the library is downloaded about 436 million times a month.
Version 13.0.0 is a large security release, with fixes across four severity levels, from low to critical, two of which are rated critical by the maintainers. None of the flaws is known to be under attack.
The weakness is the filename, not the picture. "The flaw is triggered by the filename, not by anything in the PostScript document," the advisory says, meaning a harmless EPS file can still cause damage when an attacker sets its name. That makes upload endpoints that keep or build a stored file's name from user input the realistic target.

The new issue, assigned CVE-2026-115560, affects only web applications configured in an unusual way, and PHP considers it an unlikely risk.
The project is not issuing an emergency fix for it. Instead, it recommends turning off a feature called session upload progress until a fix is available in the next routine release.
The warning came in a short informational advisory published on October 23. It follows the October 21 emergency release that fixed two critical PHP2Shell flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, which let an attacker without an account run code on a server. Those were patched in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. The new issue is separate and is not fixed by those releases.
Only a narrow setup is at risk. PHP says the problem can occur when a web application does all of the following: sets the session.serialize_handler option to php_binary or php_serialize in its configuration, then changes that option to php while running by calling ini_set(), and makes that change before it calls session_start().
Session upload progress must also still be turned on. An application that never changes the serialize handler while running can leave the feature on and is not exposed through this path. PHP says this setup is unlikely in practice.

Detrás de una hoja impresa hay un proceso que utiliza polvo plástico, calor y componentes que deben reemplazarse con frecuencia.
Las impresoras láser funcionan con tóner, un cartucho que contiene un polvo fino con micropartículas plásticas.
Ese material no se deposita sobre el papel como una tinta común: necesita altas temperaturas para adherirse a la superficie y formar letras, imágenes o gráficos.
Hay una impresora de inyección de tinta sin calor que busca reducir esto. El equipo elimina la etapa de fusión del tóner y aplica tinta líquida directamente sobre el papel, con menor consumo eléctrico y menos piezas de recambio.
Cristian Díaz, gerente de producto de impresión corporativa de Epson Colombia, señaló que una impresora láser requiere al menos ocho etapas para completar una página, mientras que la tecnología de inyección de tinta sin calor reduce el proceso a tres: recibir el archivo, aplicar la tinta y entregar la impresión.
Por qué las impresoras láser contaminan
El tóner es el insumo que usan las impresoras láser para formar textos e imágenes. Viene dentro de un cartucho y, a diferencia de la tinta líquida, está compuesto por un polvo fino que incluye micropartículas plásticas.

articles.title: Ruby Fixes Three Regex Engine Bugs Responsible for Four Critical GitLab RCE Flaws
articles.summary:
Ruby has released versions 4.0.9, 3.4.12, and 3.3.13 to fix three bugs in Onigmo, the regular expression engine built into the language. The bugs lie behind four critical security flaws that GitLab patched over the past month.
GitLab found that a specially crafted pattern could corrupt memory while Ruby compiles it, potentially leading to code execution on its own servers.
Ruby says any application that builds a regular expression from text an attacker controls is affected, not just GitLab.
Which Applications Are Affected
In its advisory, Ruby said an application is affected only if it compiles a regular expression from a string an attacker controls. That happens when a program passes such a string to Regexp.new, Regexp.union or Regexp.compile, or places it inside a pattern through interpolation, as in /#{input}/.
Applications that only use regular expressions written by their own developers are not affected.
Ruby fixed the bugs in 4.0.9, 3.4.12, and 3.3.13. The 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 releases are the first in their series to carry any of the three fixes.
An earlier release from the same week, 4.0.8, does not include the fix for one of the flaws, CVE-2026-110264, so 4.0 users should install 4.0.9.
Ruby 3.2 and earlier will not get a fix. Ruby 3.2 reached end of life on April 1, 2026, and 3.2.11 was its final release. Ruby recommends moving to 3.4 or 4.0.
If you cannot upgrade yet, the advisory says to stop compiling regular expressions from untrusted input.

articles.title: Researchers Push Over 2 Million Updates to Remotely Disable Popcorn Time Updater That Could Fuel a Botnet
articles.summary:
Between November 2025 and March 2026, the Dutch security firm Eye Security pushed more than 2 million updates to computers it did not own to switch off a background updater that it said could have allowed an outsider to take over the machine.
The updater belongs to Time4Popcorn, an abandoned copy of Popcorn Time, a free app that streamed pirated films and TV over BitTorrent.
Popcorn Time was popular about a decade ago, and the original shut down in 2014, but several copies kept running under the same name. A separate, legal project that took the Popcorn Time name in early 2025 is unrelated to it.
Eye Security, which monitors client networks for threats, found the updater during a routine threat hunt: a program called Updater.exe on one client's laptop kept trying to reach a web address that was no longer registered.
The firm registered the address itself to see what would connect, and about 50 requests a second poured in. It later laid out the operation, which it named Operation IXIM, in a write-up and a talk at Hack.lu on October 22.
Over six months, those requests carried more than 3.8 million different hardware IDs. The IDs proved an unreliable way to count machines, because some Windows PCs shared one and some Macs changed theirs, so Eye revised its estimate to 2.5 to 3 million Windows computers and 250,000 to 350,000 Macs.
The updater ran in the background on Windows and Mac from the moment the computer started. It checked for new versions over an unencrypted connection …

articles.title: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software
articles.summary:
A memory-corruption flaw in Google's Brotli decoder sits in many programs that unpack Brotli-compressed data, among them Bun, the Python Brotli and brotlicffi packages, and Envoy proxies set up to decompress Brotli.
Tracked as CVE-2026-111497, the flaw allows crafted compressed data to overwrite past the end of a buffer and corrupt a program's memory, potentially causing a crash, a memory leak, or the execution of attacker-controlled code.
Imperva researchers have shown that code can run on one unpatched Node.js build. The same has not been demonstrated on the other software, and no real-world attacks have been reported.
The flaw was first disclosed on October 21, when Node.js and Google shipped fixes, and more have followed product by product since. Because the bug is in Google's decoder and each program ships its own copy of it, every one has to update that copy on its own.
Brotli is a compression format from Google, used across the web to shrink pages and other traffic. The bug is in the C code that unpacks a Brotli stream, so it travels into anything that reuses that code, from language runtimes to proxies to Python packages.

Across the past few days, we've had big updates from three of the biggest companies in robotics — Unitree, Tesla and Figure — so there's a lot to catch up on when it comes to where these robots are now. The good news is that they'll be tackling the major jobs first: tidying up after us.
Robots, upgraded by robots
The news from Unitree this week (via the South China Morning Post) is that it's developing an AI system that will enable its humanoid robots to effectively improve on their own, without any input from human engineers. This "self-evolving" feedback loop will lead to robots writing their own code and simulations, Unitree says.
"In the past, every robotics engineer had to write code and debug manually, which is relatively inefficient," Unitree founder Wang Xingxing said at an AI conference hosted by his company. "As AI models improve, we expect them to take on more of the planning and iteration, reducing the need for human intervention."

articles.title: MacBook Neo : Apple résiste mieux que ses rivaux à la crise du PC
articles.summary:
Le marché du PC décroche, mais Apple parvient à limiter la casse. Alors que les livraisons mondiales ont plongé de 21 % au troisième trimestre 2026, le MacBook Neo aurait aidé la marque à résister bien mieux que ses principaux concurrents.
Le marché mondial du PC traverse définitivement une mauvaise passe. Au troisième trimestre 2026, seuls 57 millions d’ordinateurs ont été livrés, soit 21 % de moins qu’un an plus tôt, selon le dernier rapport de Counterpoint Research publié hier. Pourtant, Apple encaisse le choc mieux que ses concurrents et gagne même des parts de marché. Une performance que le cabinet attribue en partie au MacBook Neo.
Le MacBook Neo aide Apple à gagner des parts de marché
Le géant de Cupertino a livré 5,6 millions de Mac au troisième trimestre, soit un recul de 11 % sur un an. Malgré cette baisse, sa part du marché mondial est passée de 8,7 % à 9,8 %, selon le rapport publié par Counterpoint Research. Le cabinet attribue en partie cette meilleure résistance au MacBook Neo, qui aurait contribué à amortir le repli des livraisons.
Apple se classe ainsi au quatrième rang mondial, derrière Lenovo, HP et Dell, mais devant ASUS. Du côté de la concurrence, la chute est bien plus brutale : Lenovo a vu ses livraisons diminuer de 23 %, HP de 31 % et Dell de 25 %. ASUS limite davantage le recul, avec une baisse de 7 %.

articles.title: I’ve driven this miniature Porsche 550 — and the 80%-scale Spyder tribute is exactly as fun as it looks
articles.summary:
I've driven the tiny, electrified Hedley Studios Porsche 550 J — and this miniature motorsport legend is exactly as fun as it looks
It might only be to 80% scale but it's 100% hilarious to drive
There has been an increase in demand for compact electric vehicles as city streets get more congested and drivers feel the urge to move away from bloated, heavy SUVs that don’t fit in with daily life.
But Hedley Studios, formerly known as the Little Car Company, has taken this thinking one step further — dedicating its life to producing perfect miniaturized replicas of some of the most famous and sought-after cars on the planet.
Far from simply being a purveyor of toys for kids who never grow up, the company says it stands at the “intersection between art and automotive excellence,” crafting hand-built, electrified interpretations of the Bentley Blower, a 75% scale iteration of the Bugatti Type 35, and a baby Bond Aston Martin DB5, to name but a few.
Now, the British company has signed up its sixth official partner in Porsche, and it has turned its hand to arguably one of the most iconic models in its back catalog: the 550 Spyder.
Shaped like a silver speeding bullet, the 1950s roadster took a class win at Le Mans, dominated Italy’s infamous Targa Florio, and, sadly, became the last car Hollywood megastar James Dean ever drove.

articles.title: Après les réseaux sociaux, les affiches générées par IA envahissent nos villes et la riposte s’organise
articles.summary:
Les comités des fêtes et les petits commerces ont confié cet été à des générateurs d’images leurs annonces de vide-greniers et leurs menus, reconnaissables entre mille par leurs ressemblances. Quelques mairies tentent maintenant de freiner le mouvement avec leurs panneaux d’affichage et l’argent qu’elles versent aux associations, sans toujours montrer l’exemple.
À Igny-Comblizy, dans la Marne, la secrétaire du comité des fêtes ne regrette rien. « C’est efficace », a-t-elle confié à la presse régionale, en admettant qu’elle obtient rarement le bon résultat à la première tentative. Dans la Manche, la responsable d’une friperie associative se félicite de produire des affiches colorées, là où sa structure se contentait auparavant d’une publication sur les réseaux sociaux. Ces bénévoles ne retirent rien à un graphiste. Sans budget de communication, ils fabriquaient leurs affiches sur un traitement de texte, ou se passaient d’affiche.
Les générateurs d’images gratuits ont changé cette équation. Une phrase tapée sur un téléphone donne un visuel coloré, avec le titre de l’événement intégré à l’image. Terence Renaudeau, patron du restaurant Le Cercle à Brétignolles-sur-Mer, en Vendée, fabrique ses menus et ses annonces avec la version payante de ChatGPT. Avant, il dessinait ses visuels sur Canva sans jamais faire appel à un graphiste, et l’argent économisé l’aide à garder son établissement ouvert toute l’année et à payer une salariée en CDD chargée des réseaux sociaux.

articles.title: Xbox aurait réclamé 800 millions de dollars à Netflix pour adapter ses jeux en films et séries
articles.summary:
Netflix aurait proposé 500 millions de dollars pour exploiter les personnages les plus populaires de Xbox pendant sept ans, avec une exclusivité sur ses films et séries. Microsoft en aurait demandé 300 millions de plus, et les négociations auraient finalement échoué.
Les adaptations de jeux vidéo séduisent de plus en plus les plateformes de streaming : The Last of Us sur HBO, Fallout sur Prime Video ou encore Arcane sur Netflix. Mais obtenir les droits des licences les plus convoitées peut souvent coûter cher. Selon une enquête de Puck, Netflix aurait ainsi proposé un accord de sept ans à Xbox pour adapter ses personnages emblématiques en films et en séries. Les deux entreprises ne seraient toutefois pas parvenues à s’entendre sur le montant.
Netflix et Xbox n’auraient pas trouvé d’accord sur le prix
D’après trois sources proches du dossier citées par Puck, Netflix aurait mis 500 millions de dollars sur la table pour obtenir les droits d’exploitation des propriétés intellectuelles de Xbox pendant sept ans. L’accord prévoyait une exclusivité sur la plateforme pour les productions concernées. Microsoft aurait cependant réclamé 800 millions de dollars, soit 300 millions de plus que l’offre initiale de Netflix.
